title: Nami Skyla Prime
extract:
The Nami Skyla Prime is the Prime variant to the  Nami Skyla, sporting higher damage, critical chance and status chance, and attack speed. It was released alongside  Hydroid Prime and  Ballistica Prime.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Carving Mantis,  Crossing Snakes and  Dividing Blades (Conclave only) stance.
Two innate  and one  polarities.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Tied with  Dual Ether for the third highest base damage of all dual swords, behind  Twin Basolk and  Twin Krohkur.
Second highest status chance of all dual swords, behind Twin Basolk.
Fastest attack speed of all dual swords.

Acquisition

Vaultings
On June 28, 2019, it was announced that Nami Skyla Prime, alongside  Hydroid Prime and  Ballistica Prime, would enter the Prime Vault and be retired from the reward tables on July 6, 2019. Any preexisting components or fully-built weapons will remain as is.
From November 30, 2021 to December 7, 2021, Nami Skyla Prime was available during Prime Resurgence
